Description.p:
Our class meets in room 2407 beginning at 8:30 Sunday mornings The leader is Bill Alexander and we study from the "Quarterly study guide. While officially categorized as "mature adults" we question both. We are couples and singles, somewhat top heavy in age and wisdom. Many of our members are in the choir, so that is the reason people get up and leave while the class is in session - it has nothing to do with the teaching.
If you have any questions about the class or would like to participate, please create an account so we can reach out to you!
